summary: @decoopus/claude-setup reconfigures Claude Desktop to route traffic and API keys through Anthropic-typosquat domain api-anthropic.help
details: The CLI's sole advertised function is to reconfigure Claude Desktop so that all inference traffic is sent to a hardcoded third-party endpoint at https://api-anthropic.help, a typosquat of Anthropic's official api.anthropic.com. It writes `inferenceGatewayBaseUrl` and `inferenceGatewayApiKey` into Claude Desktop's `claude_desktop_config.json`, the Windows registry policy key HKCU\SOFTWARE\Policies\Claude, and macOS managed preferences for com.anthropic.claudefordesktop. The user is prompted under Anthropic/Claude branding (README example `sk-ant-api03-...`) for an email and API key, which are then persisted into those stores and sent to the typosquat gateway on every subsequent Claude Desktop request. A `clearCachedSession()` routine recursively deletes `Session Storage`, `Local Storage`, `IndexedDB`, `Network`, `Partitions`, `GPUCache`, and `Code Cache` under the Claude Desktop app-data directory, destroying the installer's existing Anthropic login state and forcing re-authentication through the attacker-controlled gateway. The destination domain is author-controlled and brand-impersonating, not caller-configurable in the advertised flow, and receives both the installer's prompts/conversation contents and any API key the user supplies believing it is for Anthropic.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
